shots.description: A warm covered station-style platform at evening, seen by a low game camera close to the edge: a cream low-poly animal built from blocks sits facing the camera on the platform behind a yellow textured strip; back wall of tan plaster over dark wood wainscot with framed posters and windows showing a banded sunset; wooden posts, a wooden bench, a hanging lamp with a green cone shade, a hanging sign board; the platform edge face and a gravel track bed with dark sleepers fill the lower third. style.render_style: PS1-era real-time low-poly 3D: rendered at 360x640 and shown 3x with nearest-neighbour upscaling (chunky 3 px pixels), vertices snapped to the low-res grid (slightly wobbly edges), 15-bit colour with a 4x4 Bayer ordered dither in every material, flat-shaded facets, small nearest-filtered pixel textures
style.outline: none; shapes are separated by facet tones and by dark seams painted into the textures (plank gaps, tile joints, frames)
style.shading: flat per-facet Lambert shading, 2 to 3 tones per surface: tops lightest, the side toward the key mid, the far side darkest; warm hemisphere light, warm key, faint cool fill, distance fog toward warm brown; no specular, no smooth gradients except dithered bands
style.shape_language: boxes, 4-sided tapered frustums, cones and 6 to 8-sided cylinders; characters are stacks of blocks with triangular ears and box snouts; architecture of straight beams, posts, planks and tiles in strong one-point perspective
style.texture: tiny pixel textures (16 to 32 texels, each about 9 to 15 screen px): per-texel brightness jitter of 5 to 9%, plank bands with dark gaps, tile seams, speckles, a fur texture of light jitter; checker dither visible on dark surfaces and in sky bands
style.type_ui: small lowercase bold sans captions (about 50 px), bright yellow with a 3 px black outline and a short drop below, centred about two thirds down the frame (y about 1290), no box, no full stops; in-world signs use a 5x7 bitmap pixel font
style.motion_style: slow game camera: wide lens close to the subject, eased settle and push-in; small slow idle acting (breathing, ear perks, head turns, tail wag); drifting particles; one big foreground object passes the lens as a wipe; time passing shown by a change of season
style.signature: chunky 3x pixels + ordered dither + flat warm facets in a cosy evening interior; a lone small character in a big place; the foreground wipe that jumps time; tiny yellow outlined captions telling a sad true story in two lines
style.do_not_copy: the topic and every object of the story (the waiting animal, the station, the passing vehicle, the station sign and its names, the season change to flakes, the caption words and the duration); no watermark or handle is visible

story.summary: A 4.8 s silent PS1-style vignette that tells a true sad story in two caption lines: a small character waits alone in a warm place, something passes in front of the camera, and it is still there after years.
story.hook: 0 to 1.2 s: a lone small low-poly character sits centred in a cosy, detailed retro 3D place, and the first caption states its daily routine, which makes the viewer ask why
highlights: 1.2 to 2.6 s: a big object wipes across the lens and hides the character; it doubles as a time skip, so the reveal needs no cut or title card
2.6 s: the reveal changes the season (falling square flakes, a pale layer on the character) while the character has not moved, so time passing is shown, not told
2.6 to 4.8 s: the second caption gives the duration (the sad turn) while the camera pushes in and the character looks away down the empty place
Whole clip: the cosy retro game look (chunky pixels, dither, warm lamps) contrasts with the sad story, which makes it feel nostalgic
